scripts.lhci:desktop: bun run preview:start && (npx lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.json; code=$?; bun run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.lhci:mobile: bun run preview:start && (npx lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.mobile.json; code=$?; bun run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.test:a11y: bun run preview:start && (npx playwright test tests/a11y.spec.ts; code=$?; bun run preview:stop; exit $code)
scripts.test:e2e: bun run preview:start && (npx playwright test tests/e2e; code=$?; bun run preview:stop; exit $code)
